summary: Diksha Arora is a Kolkata-based career coach, former lawyer, and content creator with over 2 million Instagram followers. She pivoted from a legal career (LLB from University of Delhi) to education and e-learning, currently running 'Diksha Arora Dot Com LLP'. She is recognized as a 'National Bestseller Author' and has received awards from Times of India and Hurun India for her work in career mentoring and interview preparation.
